richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhalswa Jahangir Pur

c: Bhalswa Jahangir Pur is a densely built part of north-west Delhi, close to Bhalswa lake, where open space is limited and every small park is in use from early morning. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment here for resident welfare associations, colony parks, schools and community grounds. We manufacture the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 1,130 km away, and deliver to Delhi by road.

A park in a crowded colony gets far more users per machine than a large city garden. The equipment has to take hard daily use from teenagers as well as gentle use from elderly residents. We suggest fewer, sturdier stations over a long row of light ones. Delhi's weather adds its own load, with fierce heat from April to June and damp, smoggy winter mornings. For this reason the frames are galvanised and the seats are roto-moulded plastic that does not crack in the sun.

items.q: Can an RWA in north-west Delhi order just two or three machines?
items.a: Yes. Many associations start small and add stations later, since each machine has its own footing. Send us the park size and photos and we will mark the best spots on a drawing.

items.q: How do the machines handle Delhi's summer heat?
items.a: Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts take the heat without rusting or cracking. Lighter colours stay cooler to touch. Place the gym near trees if you can, as most people use it early or late.

items.q: Is the equipment safe for children to play on?
items.a: Outdoor gym machines are meant for teenagers and adults. Keep them apart from the children's play area and put up a simple sign. We can mark a separate zone for each on your layout.
